nodes.name: Daily 09:00 UTC
nodes.notes: Runs daily at 09:00 UTC to generate the cost report.

nodes.name: Fetch Workflows
nodes.notes: Fetches all workflows from the n8n API to build an ID-to-name map for cost attribution.

nodes.name: Fetch Executions
nodes.notes: Fetches up to 250 recent successful executions. The Code node filters to the last 24h.

nodes.name: Calculate Costs
nodes.notes: Filters executions to last 24h, maps workflows to AI models (Haiku/Sonnet), estimates token costs. Stores daily costs in staticData for 7-day rolling average.

nodes.name: Over 150% Average?
nodes.notes: Checks if today's cost exceeds 150% of the 7-day rolling average. Requires at least 2 days of history.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $('Calculate Costs').first().json;
return [{ json: {
  title: '[COST ALERT] Daily AI spend ($' + d.daily_cost + ') exceeds 150% of 7-day average',
  body: '> 🤖 **This is an automated message from the DevLLMOps AI Agent**

'
    + '**Daily AI spend ($' + d.daily_cost + ') exceeds 150% of the 7-day rolling average ($' + d.rolling_average_7d + ').**

'
    + '<details>
<summary>View cost breakdown</summary>

'
    + '| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
'
    + '| **Daily spend** | $' + d.daily_cost + ' |
'
    + '| **7-day average** | $' + d.rolling_average_7d + ' |
'
    + '| **Month-to-date** | $' + d.month_to_date + ' |
'
    + '| **Input tokens** | ' + d.input_tokens + ' |
'
    + '| **Output tokens** | ' + d.output_tokens + ' |
'
    + '| **Executions** | ' + d.execution_count + ' |

'
    + '### Breakdown

' + d.breakdown + '
'
    + '### Recommended actions

'
    + '- Review prompt efficiency
'
    + '- Check for runaway automation loops
'
    + '- Consider using Haiku for routine tasks

'
    + '</details>',
  labels: ['cost-alert']
} }];

nodes.name: Build Cost Alert Body
nodes.notes: Formats the cost alert issue with AI header, summary, and collapsible breakdown.

nodes.name: Create Cost Alert Issue
nodes.notes: Creates a GitHub issue flagging the cost overrun.
